findings.currentDescription: Die lernende Person kann einfache MO-Diagramme (z. B. O2, N2) interpretieren und Bindungsordnung ableiten.
literalPrimaryFacts: RP p56 assigns molecular orbital theory to the optional Leistungskurs 8.7 module, W 5 h. p19 allows breadth/depth selection within optional modules; generic p12-15 modelling/interpretation operators do not specify bond-order calculation.

SL EP NW and language branches p18 require modelling singly occupied s/p orbital overlap and orbital representations for hydrogen, halogens and hydrogen halides; no O2/N2 energy-schema/bond-order operation is stated.

Current official BY C12 gA/eA LB4 explicitly couples an inference of diatomic molecule/ion existence from energy schemas with binding/antibinding MO content and N2/O2 examples. The local competency-only source extraction omitted this explanatory content context.
findings.wholeCurrentGoalAuthorInterpretation: The BY named MO model and explicit O2/N2 binding relationships make interpreting a supplied scheme and deriving its net bond order a bounded quantitative operationalization of the prescribed diagram inference. The term and arithmetic definition of bond order are inferred by the author; neither is misquoted as literal. This full local model context, rather than the bare RP MO term, supports the candidate.
independentReviewerMustCheck: Does the BY full model/context legitimately support the quantitative bond-order aspect rather than only a binary existence inference?
Does the source-cell candidate preserve all existing cluster/leaf partner semantics and both merged BY course occurrences?
Do exact current source/goal bindings permit any new provider/course projection without unauthorized canonical tag changes?

findings.currentDescription: Die lernende Person kann die Reaktivität von Carbonsäurechloriden, Carbonsäureanhydriden und Carbonsäureestern bei vergleichbaren nucleophilen Acylsubstitutionen ordnen und die Unterschiede anhand von Carbonylgruppe und Abgangsgruppe begründen.
literalPrimaryFacts: RP p40 names acid anhydrides and acid chlorides in the grey optional enrichment/networking box. The ester mechanism is in the separate required Leistungskurs Additum.
The same grey box gives the effect of carbonyl activity on reaction speed and equilibrium; it does not state a three-class acyl-reactivity ordering or a comparative leaving-group argument.
RP p19-21 establishes selection and table semantics. General model/mechanism and data operators p12-15 allow author teaching choices but do not remove this missing whole-goal depth.
findings.wholeCurrentGoalAuthorInterpretation: Applying the ester addition-elimination idea to the optional derivative examples is reasonable authored enrichment. The required three-class ordering plus a carbonyl-and-leaving-group justification adds a specific comparative mechanism commitment absent from the viewed source cell/context. Carbonyl activity and adjacent generic mechanisms cannot substitute for the missing complete current target.

currentGoalRemediationProposal.proposedDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Carbonsäurechloride, Carbonsäureanhydride und Carbonsäureester anhand ihrer funktionellen Gruppen in vorgegebenen Strukturformeln unterscheiden und jeweils eine angegebene Verwendung als Carbonsäurederivat zuordnen.
currentGoalRemediationProposal.sourceScope: Bounded optional RP enrichment, with given exemplars/context; not a compulsory Hessen or all-jurisdiction claim.
currentGoalRemediationProposal.tradeoff: This is a different, narrower structural/application competence and drops comparative acyl-reactivity and leaving-group depth. It requires honest goal/page/profile/image/context review; do not apply silently or relabel the current goal as runtime/orientation to hide it.

findings.currentDescription: Die lernende Person kann die intramolekulare Esterbildung aus vorgegebenen Hydroxycarbonsäuren anhand von Strukturformeln erklären und Bildungstendenz sowie relative Stabilität der entstehenden Lactone unter angegebenen Bedingungen anhand von Ringstruktur und Vergleichsdaten begründen.
literalPrimaryFacts: HE current p39 Q1.3 covers hydroxy/amino acid structural forms and ester synthesis/condensation including a mechanistic consideration. p40 elevated content covers alkaline ester hydrolysis and di/tricarboxylic-acid structure.
No lactone or intramolecular ester ring formation and no relative ring-stability/formation-tendency comparison is stated on those current original pages.
The 30 current local source PDF snapshots contain no lactone/lakton or bond-order literal discovery hit; a keyword scan is discovery only and is not proof of full-source absence.
findings.wholeCurrentGoalAuthorInterpretation: Hydroxy acid plus ester synthesis supplies background for a possible authored lactone transfer, but not a whole-goal witness. Explaining intramolecular ring closure and comparing lactone formation/stability under conditions requires an additional concrete content/model/data commitment. Neither a generic ester source nor prerequisite mastery fills that requirement.

currentGoalRemediationProposal.proposedDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Hydroxycarbonsäuren anhand der Hydroxy- und Carboxygruppe in vorgegebenen Struktur- und Skelettformeln erkennen und von einfachen Carbonsäuren und Aminocarbonsäuren unterscheiden.
currentGoalRemediationProposal.sourceScope: HE current Q1.3 structural hydroxy/amino-acid statement only; no lactone stability claim.
currentGoalRemediationProposal.tradeoff: This changes the identity and lowers the demand of the current lactone goal. It requires an explicit replacement/split decision, source/projection review and new P/A/M/D/V bindings; current lactone assets and evidence remain historical until judged.
currentGoalRemediationProposal.preferredNextAction: Keep HOLD on the current unchanged goal while a concrete source for intramolecular ester rings and condition-dependent comparison is established, or make an explicit content redesign after checking duplicates.
